SELECT pih.pet_nm, pih.birth_dt, pih.weight, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('PET_TYPE',pih.pet_type_cd, false), NULL) AS pet_type_cd, IFNULL(fn_codeNm(pih.pet_type_cd ,pih.pet_kind_cd, false), NULL) AS pet_kind_cd, pih.neutralize_fl, pih.sex, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('FEED_KIND', pih.pet_feed_kind_cd, false), NULL) AS pet_feed_kind_cd, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('INTEREST_INFO', pih.interest_info_cd_lst, false),NULL) AS interest_info_cd_lst, bf.bf_fileurl AS pet_file_url, pih.del_fl, pih.create_ymd, pih.create_id, pih.update_ymd, pih.update_id FROM pet_urine_check_history puch INNER JOIN pet_info_history pih ON puch.pet_history_id = pih.pet_history_id LEFT JOIN g5_board_file bf ON puch.pet_id = bf.wr_id AND bf.bo_table = 'pet_info' WHERE puch.urine_check_history_id = #{urineCheckHistoryId} AND puch.del_fl = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_ship_invoice(od_id, od_delivery_company, od_invoice,create_id) SELECT #{odId}, #{odDeliveryCompany}, #{odInvoice}, #{createOrUpdateId} FROM g5_shop_order g5so WHERE g5so.od_id = #{odId}
mapper.update: UPDATE g5_shop_order g5so INNER JOIN pet_ship_invoice psi ON psi.od_id = g5so.od_id SET g5so.od_invoice = psi.od_invoice, g5so.od_invoice_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, g5so.od_status = '배송' WHERE g5so.od_status = '준비'
mapper.select: SELECT g5so.od_id, g5so.od_b_name, g5so.od_b_tel, CONCAT(g5so.od_b_addr1, ' ', g5so.od_b_addr2, ' ', g5so.od_b_addr3, ' ', g5so.od_b_zip1, g5so.od_b_zip2) AS address, g5sc.it_id, g5so.od_cart_count, CASE WHEN g5si.it_3 = '' THEN '1000' ELSE g5si.it_3 END AS od_cart_weight, pcc.code_nm AS od_delivery_company, g5so.od_invoice, g5so.od_status, g5so.od_time, g5so.od_memo, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('PET_TYPE', pih.pet_type_cd, true), NULL) AS pet_type_cd, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('PET_KIND', pih.pet_kind_cd, true), NULL) AS pet_kind_cd, pih.pet_nm, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('SEX', pih.sex, true), NULL) AS sex, CASE WHEN pih.neutralize_fl = 0 THEN '중성화' ELSE '비중성화' END AS neutralize_fl, pih.birth_dt, pih.weight, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('BODY_KIND', pih.body_kind_cd, true), NULL) AS body_kind_cd, CASE WHEN pih.allergy_fl = 0 OR pih.allergy_fl = 3 THEN '유' ELSE '무' END AS allergy_fl, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('ALLERGY', pih.allergy_cd_lst, false), NULL) AS allergy_cd_lst, CONCAT(pih.pet_activity_hour, '시', pih.pet_activity_minute, '분') AS pet_activity_time, CONCAT(pih.pet_sleep_time_hour, '시', pih.pet_sleep_time_minute, '분') AS pet_sleep_time, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('FEED_KIND', pih.pet_feed_kind_cd, true), NULL) AS pet_feed_kind_cd, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('WATER', pih.water_cd, true), NULL) AS water_cd, pih.water_ml, IFNULL(fn_codeNm('INTEREST_INFO', pih.interest_info_cd_lst, false), NULL) AS interest_info_cd_lst, pih.interest_info_etc, CASE WHEN pih.hospital_ck = 0 THEN '무' ELSE '유' END AS hospital_ck, pih.hospital_msg, pih.pet_pee, pih.pet_dung, -- 비만도 CASE WHEN puch.obesity_result_score = 5 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.obesity_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.obesity_result_score = 3 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS obesity_result, -- 잠혈 CASE WHEN puch.blood_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.blood_result_score = 0 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS blood_result, -- 빌리루빈 CASE WHEN puch.bilirubin_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.bilirubin_result_score = 0 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS bilirubin_result, -- 우노빌리로겐 CASE WHEN puch.urobilinogen_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.urobilinogen_result_score = 0 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS urobilinogen_result, -- 케톤 CASE WHEN puch.ketone_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.ketone_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.ketone_result_score = 0 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS ketone_result, -- 단백뇨 CASE WHEN puch.protein_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.protein_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.protein_result_score = 0 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS protein_result, -- 아질산염 CASE WHEN puch.nitrite_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' ELSE '주의' END AS nitrite_result, -- 포도당 CASE WHEN puch.glucose_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' ELSE '주의' END AS glucose_result, -- PH CASE WHEN puch.ph_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.ph_result_score = 2 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.ph_result_score = 0 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS ph_result, -- 뇨비중 CASE WHEN puch.sg_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' ELSE '주의' END AS sg_result, -- 백혈구 CASE WHEN puch.leukocyte_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.leukocyte_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.leukocyte_result_score = 0 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS leukocyte_result, -- 아스코르브산 CASE WHEN puch.ascorbic_acid_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' ELSE '관심' END AS ascorbic_acid_result, -- 중성화결과 CASE WHEN puch.neutralize_result_score = 6 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.neutralize_result_score = 0 THEN '관심' ELSE '비정상' END AS neutralize_result, -- 관심항목 CASE WHEN puch.interest_info_result_score = 3 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.interest_info_result_score = 2 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.interest_info_result_score = 1 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS interest_info_result, -- 음수량 CASE WHEN puch.water_result_score = 5 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.water_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.water_result_score = 3 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS water_result, -- 알러지 CASE WHEN puch.allergy_result_score = 3 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.allergy_result_score = 2 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.allergy_result_score = 1 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS allergy_result, -- 산책 시간 CASE WHEN puch.activity_time_result_score = 5 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.activity_time_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.activity_time_result_score = 3 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS activity_time_result, -- 수면 시간 CASE WHEN puch.sleep_time_result_score = 5 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.sleep_time_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.sleep_time_result_score = 3 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS sleep_time_result, -- 소변 횟수 CASE WHEN puch.pee_result_score = 5 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.pee_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.pee_result_score = 3 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS pee_result, -- 대변 횟수 CASE WHEN puch.dung_result_score = 5 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.dung_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.dung_result_score = 3 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS dung_result, CASE WHEN puch.obesity_result_score = 5 THEN '정상' WHEN puch.obesity_result_score = 4 THEN '관심' WHEN puch.obesity_result_score = 3 THEN '주의' ELSE '비정상' END AS body_kind_result FROM g5_shop_order g5so INNER JOIN g5_shop_cart g5sc ON g5so.od_id = g5sc.od_id INNER JOIN g5_shop_item g5si ON g5sc.it_id = g5si.it_id INNER JOIN pet_urine_check_history puch ON g5sc.urine_check_history_id = puch.urine_check_history_id INNER JOIN pet_info_history pih ON g5sc.pet_history_id = pih.pet_history_id INNER JOIN pet_common_code pcc ON g5so.od_delivery_company = pcc.code_cd WHERE g5sc.ct_id = #{ctId} AND g5si.it_10 = 'use';
